title: Session: 2.14 embed replies instead of JSON
objective: Validate 2.14.0 or later on DevBot: every command, button and notice answers with one house-style embed instead of a JSON dump. Errors end with Code · Ref matching the bot log, member views hide job and entry IDs, officer views add delivery detail, and nothing pings anyone. A second pass with Discord changes paused checks what imported guilds show at launch. Replies are public here to compare with the approved mockups.
user: Deploy 2.14.0 or later (no migration) and register commands; run `/version`, `/ping`, `/channel`, `/config show` and `/config validate`.
`/claim` a test character, `/verify` before and after publishing the token, then `/characters`, `/main`, `/nickname enabled:true` and `/unclaim`.
`/ledger deposit` as a member; as an officer, an oversized then a valid `/ledger withdraw`; then `/ledger balance` and `/ledger history` with Older.
`/guest status` as member and as officer with member:, `/guest grant`, `/guest revoke`; clear guest_applications, try `/apply`, then restore it.
As a non-officer try `/config show`, `/ledger withdraw` and `/characters member:` for someone else; send a blank note and a bad run_id.
`/refresh`, then `/sync status` as member and officer; as officer open Full details (JSON).
Paused pass: restart with `ENABLE_EFFECTS=false`, repeat `/nickname`, `/guest grant` and `/refresh`, run `/sync status` and `/config validate`, then restore effects.
assistant: Compare each reply with the approved mockups: title, tone color, fields, footer and buttons. Flag any JSON, raw UUID in a member view, ISO time or parsed mention.
Match every error's Ref to the log `operation` and its Code to the logged `code`; confirm no stack, SQL or token text reached Discord.
Read back the ledger channel posts and the officer-chat review message: one embed, no mentions, full entry ID present.

Paused pass: receipts are the pending "Saved, Discord changes paused" card with `‖ PAUSED`, never QUEUED or "shortly"; sync views show paused work (none once effects return); /config validate warns "[WARN] Disabled for this deployment" (ENABLE_EFFECTS=false is deployment_disabled; DevBot has no unactivated guild and no worker may use tarubot_rehearsal, so the "ready for activation" verdict of configuration#9 is covered by the unit case configuration/validate.ready).
Record deviations with command, audience and message ID in docs/DEV_GUILD.md, fix them, and re-run the affected step.
bot: Run compiled 2.14.0 or later on schema 005 with the same decisions as 2.13.0; held work now resumes when the bot restarts with effects on.
Answer each interaction with one house-style embed, public in this test guild and ephemeral elsewhere, with no parsed mentions.
Post ledger entries and decision DMs as embeds and move review messages to one embed on their next update; officer notices stay plain text until 2.15.0.
Hold Discord changes during the paused pass, then requeue the held work and reconcile the guild again when it restarts with effects on.
Post this responsibility-separated session plan in #chat.
